_README.purpose: Passive numeric buffs emitted as native ActiveEffects on the talent (Effects tab). foundry-build.js writes each entry into the talent's `effects` array; transfer:true applies it to the owner while the talent is owned. Keyed by exact talent name. A talent may map to one effect object or an array of them.

fields.label: Effect name shown on the Effects tab (defaults to the talent name).
fields.changes: Array of { key, mode, value }. mode 2 = ADD (default). key is an actor data path. Numeric derived values add via their `.bonus` subfield, e.g. 'system.movement.walk.rate.bonus', 'system.defenses.phy.bonus', 'system.resources.foc.max.bonus', 'system.deflect.bonus'. Roll-data refs like '@tier' are resolved at apply time by the system.
fields.disabled: OPTIONAL, default false. true = baked toggled-OFF (for conditional passives the player enables on the actor's Effects tab when the condition holds).

_README.coverage: Walking Ruin (+Speed), Composed (+Tier focus max - Scholar AND Leader trees share the name, one entry covers both), Customary Garb (+2 PHY/SPI while presentably dressed), Collected (+2 COG/SPI), Guardian Stance (+1 Deflect while an ally is adjacent - baked disabled; toggle it on the actor).

Composed.label: Composed — Focus
Composed.description: Increase your max (and current) focus by your tier. (Current focus tops up on rest; nudge it manually after gaining this.)

Customary Garb.label: Customary Garb — Defenses
Customary Garb.description: While wearing Presentable armor or appropriate clothing: +2 Physical and Spiritual defense. Toggle off on the actor if not presentably dressed.

Guardian Stance.label: Guardian Stance — Deflect
Guardian Stance.description: While an ally is adjacent to you, you both gain +1 Deflect. Baked toggled-OFF — enable on the actor's Effects tab while the condition holds (the adjacent ally's copy is tracked manually).

Walking Ruin.label: Walking Ruin — Speed
Walking Ruin.description: Destruction (Razkael). +10 ft Speed. (Passive: every space you move through also becomes dangerous terrain for the scene — tracked manually.)
